name: MGL shared texture library
note: Made from formulas by editor/scripts/make-mgl-library.mjs; no image comes from anywhere else.

items.description: A soft edge: light fades into shade over a wide band.
A hard edge: one step from shade to light.
Skin: a fairly sharp edge with a warm red band along it, like light passing through skin.
Hair: a sharp edge (its slightly cool band shows only where a ramp's color is used, on skin and faces).
For eyes (added): a clear window highlight up left and a small one down right.
A soft grey studio, bright above with a horizon line (the shading adds matcaps on eyes only: on a cornea it gives a dim, even reflection).
Fine strands: many thin stripes (tile it about 8 times across).
Coarse strands: a few broad locks.
Skin shade colors: saturated and warm (a slot's Shade Table).
